title: Cloud servers
loadFailed: Unable to read this server. Refresh to try again.
processing: The operation is in progress. Status updates automatically. Wait for the current task to finish.
attention: The operation needs reconciliation. Further operations are paused. Contact support.
observationUnavailable: The upstream runtime state could not be confirmed. Operations are disabled until refreshed.
operationFailed: The request could not be confirmed. Retry the same request instead of creating another operation.
credentialHint: The initial password is available once after confirmed provisioning. Save it securely and connect using your selected operating system.
credentialObservationUnavailable: The server state is temporarily unavailable. Refresh the status before viewing the initial password.
credentialUnavailable: The initial password is not ready or was already delivered. Contact support for assistance.
credentialFailed: Password delivery did not complete. It will not be automatically retried. Refresh status or contact support.
credentialConfirmation: This password is shown only once. After closing, it cannot be viewed again. Prepare to save it securely.
powerConfirmation: Stopping or rebooting interrupts workloads. Confirm that work is saved and this action may proceed.
confirmed: I understand the impact and confirm this action
passwordOnce: Save the password securely now. Closing clears this display.
noAddresses: No IP addresses are currently allocated
addressesUnavailable: No confirmed IP addresses are available. Refresh or contact support.
waitingForProvider: The upstream channel is temporarily paused. This request has not been sent. It will resume automatically after {time}; do not submit it again.
